subject.title: fix: restore Apple builds under SwiftFormat 0.62.1

question: Should maintainers merge this Apple tooling fix after exact-head Apple CI completes, or hold it for an exact SwiftFormat pinning policy?
rationale: The PR has the protected `maintainer` label and changes CI package-manager behavior, so cleanup automation should not make the final merge/policy choice.

options.title: Merge after Apple CI passes
options.body: If `macos-swift`, `ios-build`, and iOS Periphery pass on this head, proceed with the focused Homebrew-latest mitigation.

options.title: Pin SwiftFormat exactly
options.body: Hold the PR and require a deterministic SwiftFormat 0.62.1 install path if maintainers do not want CI tracking Homebrew latest.

options.title: Pause for Apple CI owner
options.body: Leave the PR open for the Apple CI owner to choose a different formatter policy or validation bar.

recommendation.title: Merge after Apple CI passes
recommendation.body: If `macos-swift`, `ios-build`, and iOS Periphery pass on this head, proceed with the focused Homebrew-latest mitigation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to prior iOS CI work and authored this Apple formatter stabilization PR.
